messages:
maya-cs: FYI VitalBridge just hit regional limits during a partner demo. They asked for a short-lived throughput lift and IP allowlist for EU + APAC while they finish onboarding. Case 792104 created. Need quick sync.

leo-ops: Link to case? what numbers are they asking for?

maya-cs: Case 792104. Request: EU -> 3000 qps (today ~900), APAC -> 1500 qps (today ~600). Window 48h starting now, then revoke. They gave egress prefixes: 18.202.0.0/16 and 13.54.96.0/20. Prefer route to eu-central + apac-sin edges.

toni-net: I can push L4 allowlist entries on the edge ACLs for those CIDRs. Any need for BGP/peering or ASN data? If this becomes long-term we should spin up peering/ASN details.

maya-cs: L4 is fine for speed. No peering right now. Please set expiry to 172800s (48h) and annotate case: "ephemeral allowlist -> auto-expire in 48h (2024-10-04T18:00:00Z)".

vishal-eng: Which route + model? For bursts we should enforce max_concurrency=8, set max_tokens=400, and enable prefix cache. Also recommend fallback route to llama-2-13b-q4 to avoid failed requests if 70b saturates.

maya-cs: They use vb-assistant-prod -> redwood/llama-2-70b-chat-q4. Customer ok with fallback to redwood/llama-2-13b-chat-q4 if needed.

alex-sales: Heads up: renewal for VitalBridge is in 21 days. This demo is a high-impact event; please log any infra issues in the case so I can share with the AE.

toni-net: Applying ACL now. Plan: create ephemeral L4 entries on edge ACL with TTL=172800s, tag 'customer:vitalbridge', map CIDRs into eu-central & apac-sin pools. Rolling apply should take ~3m.

infra-bot: Ticket 792104-ephemeral-allowlist created by maya-cs. Assigned to toni-net. ETA SLA 3h.

leo-ops: After apply can you run a quick curl smoke test we can hand to the customer? Use this example:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
 -d '{"route":"vb-assistant-prod","input":"ping","max_tokens":10}'
```

toni-net: Done  ACLs live. Verified 200 from test IP 18.202.34.12 hitting eu-central gateway. Auto-expiry scheduled.

vishal-eng: Ran a small synthetic check under a 500qps pilot: p50 90ms, p95 400ms. No backend queueing seen but keep an eye on p99. Also enabled prefix caching for their common demo prompts.

leo-ops: Thx. Pasted smoke test to case and bumped priority. Sharing with customer now.

maya-cs: Sent confirmation to VitalBridge and scheduled a 20-minute enablement huddle with their SRE at 2024-10-03T15:00:00Z. Noted renewal window in case.

alex-sales: Nice work team :clap: I added Renewal Watch and flagged AE. Please capture any post-demo feedback in the case.

maya-cs: Will do. Case updated with smoke logs + perf snapshot. Closing loop with sales after the demo.
